title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 2) Order 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 2) Order 2014.

2.—(1) Sembcorp Utilities Pte Ltd is hereby granted exemption from tax on the dividends received in Singapore on 12th December 2011 from SCU Mauritius Pte Ltd, a company located in Mauritius.
(2) The exemption under sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 15th January 2014 addressed to Sembcorp Utilities Pte Ltd.
